input.question: Why am I allergic to cats and is their a way to get over my allergy?
input.ground_truth: Depending on the severity of your allergy you can consider [allergy shots/immunotherapy](_URL_0_). I would make an appointment with an allergy specialist as there are different levels of effectiveness depending on your specific case. I started them 3 months ago. Its a big time commitment 2x/week for ~6months and then 1x/month for 3-5 years (probably closer to 5 years).

Question: Why am I allergic to cats and is their a way to get over my allergy?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine your body is like a castle, and the things that make you sick (like cat hair) are like tiny invaders. Sometimes, your body gets confused and thinks cat hair is a bad invader, even though it’s not really dangerous. So, your body sends out special soldiers (called antibodies) to fight it, and that’s what makes you sneeze or get itchy—that’s your allergy!

Now, can you get over it? Sometimes, if you spend a little time around cats and your body gets used to them (this is called “immunotherapy”), it might stop being so scared. But you have to be careful because your body might still get upset at first. A doctor can help you figure out the best way to try this safely. 

So, you’re allergic to cats because your body thinks they’re yucky, but with help from a doctor, maybe one day your body won’t be scared of cats anymore!
